summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Admin > App Management APK upload fix (chunked POST + async job + polling). Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering public config, admin config auth, full chunk→finish→poll flow for both platforms, wrong-package rejection, garbage-zip rejection, /finish 400 on missing/partial chunks, chunk idempotency (double-send same index), mongo apk_upload_chunks cleanup after processing, and APK delete. Frontend (web_panel built with PUBLIC_URL=/api/panel): App Management page under System > App Management loads with NO 'Failed to fetch' toast, chunked customer APK upload shows apk-stage-customer stage text ('Processing — please keep this tab open'), success toast exactly 'APK uploaded · v1.6.0 (code 16)', apk-current-customer shows 'Uploaded · app.azoapp.homeservice · v1.6.0 · 2.0 MB'. Wrong-package upload (partner apk on customer tab) shows clear error 'This APK does not belong to the Customer App (found package app.azoapp.partner, expected app.azoapp.homeservice).' Delete button triggers confirm → 'Customer App APK deleted' toast, apk-current-customer cleared. Tab switch to Partner App works and renders appmgmt-form-partner.

Onboarding tour modal (role=dialog) covers the sidebar on first login and blocks keyboard/pointer events on sidebar links until Skip tour is clicked — consider auto-dismissing or lowering z-index for sidebar navigation

action_items: web_panel/build directory was absent on this preview — I rebuilt with `PUBLIC_URL=/api/panel yarn build`. Main agent should ensure the build is produced as part of the pod-reset recovery flow (or served from a dev server), otherwise /api/panel/* returns 404 and admin UI is unreachable.
critical_code_review_comments: app_management_routes.finish_upload cleanly separates fast enqueue vs. background _process_upload — prevents proxy timeouts on 150MB+ APKs. Good.
Chunk upsert on (upload_id,index) with unique index makes retries idempotent → re-sending same index does not corrupt the final file (verified by TestChunkIdempotency).
apk_upload_chunks TTL index expireAfterSeconds=6h guards against leaked chunks when the user abandons the upload.
_process_upload deletes chunks in a `finally` block → verified they are gone from mongo after both success and error paths.
Frontend uses 768KB chunks (under default Nginx client_max_body_size 1MB) + 4 parallel workers → fits typical VPS/Cloudflare proxies without special tuning. Nice.
withRetry correctly treats 400/401/403/413/404 as fatal → upload bail-out is fast on package mismatch rather than retry-looping for 6×.

Minor: _process_upload writes the full APK to a temp file then reads full bytes into memory for storage_service.put_file — for very large APKs (>500MB) consider streaming. Not blocking for the 150-200MB target.

To bypass OTP in tests, mint a JWT with middleware.auth.create_token(user_id, 'admin'); the token goes in localStorage key 'azo_token'. The App Management page lives under sidebar System > App Management. Tests at /app/backend/tests/test_app_management.py cover the full new async job contract: /chunk (idempotent per index), /finish returns {job_id, status:'processing'}, GET /status/{job_id} returns {status: 'processing'|'done'|'error', stage, error, result}.
